name: resto-hub
description: RESTO-HUB — plateforme SaaS multi-établissements de gestion pour restaurants et bars (Togo / Afrique de l'Ouest)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @resto-hub/web && npm run build -w @resto-hub/client
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w @resto-hub/shared-contracts && npm run build -w @resto-hub/service-kit && npm run build -w @resto-hub/identity-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/tenant-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/catalog-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/floor-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/order-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/loyalty-marketing-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/payment-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/staff-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/payroll-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/inventory-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/notification-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/reporting-service && npm run build -w @resto-hub/platform-admin-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @resto-hub/web && npm run typecheck -w @resto-hub/client
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:packages: npm run test -w @resto-hub/shared-contracts && npm run test -w @resto-hub/design-tokens && npm run test:template
scripts.test:services: npm run build:services && npm run test -w @resto-hub/identity-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/tenant-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/catalog-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/floor-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/order-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/loyalty-marketing-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/payment-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/staff-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/payroll-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/inventory-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/notification-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/reporting-service && npm run test -w @resto-hub/platform-admin-service
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:packages && npm run db:test && npm run openapi:check && npm run test:services
